relations: Celia；Ida（写信给 Bertie）；Bertie（收信人）；Beatrice（作者）；Roland（已死）
numbers: 至多八小时；页团近一个世纪粘连；羊皮纸（兽皮）

facts.fact: 破罐即倒计时：至多八小时，粘连的页将永远粘连；她把凝固团带去地下室
facts.anchor: I only had eight hours at most
facts.verbatim: I only had eight hours at most

facts.fact: 她的专长是预防性保护而非修复；手稿写在羊皮纸（兽皮）而非纸——古怪选择救了它免于腌渍液全灭
facts.anchor: on parchment—on animal skins—rather than paper
facts.verbatim: on parchment—on animal skins—rather than paper

facts.fact: 考虑打长途问 Folger 同行，又怕被追问来路；只要与页面独处的时间
午夜到黎明：清洁→冷冻稳定→取出分离→再冷冻，层层反复
facts.anchor: Back to the freezer. Again, and again, layer by layer.
facts.verbatim: Back to the freezer. Again, and again, layer by layer.

facts.fact: 手指如橡胶、怕走错毁掉想救的；皮肤热紧怕发烧/感染；每个声响都惊
facts.anchor: destroying what I wanted to save
facts.verbatim: destroying what I wanted to save

facts.fact: 磁带口述；金属架反光成注视的眼；每个声音都像你的脚步回来认领作品
facts.anchor: you were returning to claim your precious work
facts.verbatim: you were returning to claim your precious work

facts.fact: 不信鬼的自辩：疼痛与野生的想象；童年盼望太强以至相信自己见到了
facts.anchor: I don’t believe in ghosts, I reminded myself.
facts.verbatim: I don’t believe in ghosts, I reminded myself.

facts.fact: 《Dreams of the Rose》所知：Ozark 设定、unsettling；第一代教工记你整夜游荡、泥膝苔藓花与一次蛇皮；Eureka Springs 降神会
Ida 致 Bertie：你迷上新作几乎不分享，只答「the spring」；她既乐见又怕你专注的极端
facts.anchor: “The spring,” was all she’d tell me when I asked.
facts.verbatim: “The spring,” was all she’d tell me when I asked.

facts.fact: 酒酣夏夜你枕 Ida 膝多说：不体面故事——男人在泉中发现完美保存女尸并爱上
facts.anchor: a man who finds a perfectly preserved dead woman in a spring and falls in love
facts.verbatim: a man who finds a perfectly preserved dead woman in a spring and falls in love

facts.fact: Roland 死后 Ida 回忆：连骨架都让她睡不安；她求她写完，悲恸中似毁了；死亡成她的敌人
Celia 的事后推演：那些词必像凶兆；但她最终没毁，她藏了
